categorical.description: Primary area of vehicle circulation (Urban or Rural); urban areas typically exhibit higher frequency of minor accidents and theft.

exclusion_rationale.policy_status: Active/cancelled status is an outcome of the policy lifecycle rather than a risk predictor; including it would introduce target leakage as cancelled policies have already been priced and may have partial premiums.
exclusion_rationale.liability_premium: Component premium calculated from the same pricing process as the target variable; including it would cause severe target leakage and circularity in the model.
exclusion_rationale.property_damage_premium: Component premium derived from the same pricing basis as total_premium; direct target leakage.

exclusion_rationale.occupants_premium: Component premium derived from the same pricing basis as total_premium; direct target leakage.
exclusion_rationale.total_claims: Observed claims count is a realised outcome post-policy inception; using it as a feature would constitute target leakage in a prospective pricing model.
